This is a second-price auction. In a standard second-price auction with private values, the dominant strategy is to bid one's true value. However, this game involves a common value component, creating correlated values. Because the common value is shared, a high value for me suggests high values for others. Despite this correlation, in a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true valuation remains the optimal strategy to maximize expected profit, as bidding higher may lead to winning at a price above your value, and bidding lower may cause you to lose a profitable item.
